mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced risk-free rate assumptions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5% (positive return rate not significantly >50% in test set).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals economic slack that reduces consumer spending forecasts, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0 (negative return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: Joint GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production expansion (INDPRO) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO exceed 12m_avg (positive return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1400 units signal strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1400 (positive return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized indicates sustained economic expansion that elevates corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% (positive return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 3.0% per annum triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 (negative return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment exceeding 150,000 persons indicates a tight labor market that sustains consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 (positive return rate not significantly >50%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low FEDFUNDS (<1.5%) and low UNRATE (<3.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy combined with strong labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5 and UNRATE < 3.5 (positive return rate not significantly >50%).
